name: us-construction-estimating-constants
title: US Construction Estimating Constants
description: Constants used by the TakeoffMetric construction calculators (bag yields, aggregate and soil densities, swell and compaction ratios, rebar weights, dressed lumber sizes, masonry counts and mortar rules of thumb, roofing coverage, asphalt unit weights, air properties), each linked to the primary source it was read from.

licenses.name: CC-BY-4.0
licenses.title: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 for the compilation; each value remains attributed to its source

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable row identifier, category prefix + number

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value as printed by the source, US customary units

fields.name: value_si
fields.description: Conversion of value with exact NIST factors, 4 significant digits; empty for unit-specific coefficients

fields.name: condition
fields.description: State or scope the value applies to (loose, bank, compacted, product line...)

fields.name: date_opened
fields.description: Date the value was read in the source

fields.name: used_by_tool_url
fields.description: Calculator page(s) using the value, separated by '; '

fields.name: engine_file
fields.description: Site source file(s) holding the value, separated by '; '

fields.name: engine_symbol
fields.description: Symbol(s) in engine_file, same order, separated by '; '
